You can also adjust your notification settings by clicking on the unsubscribe link in an email footer, which unchecks the notification setting for that particular type of notification. You can opt out of most communications from >x<. As part of providing the >x< service, we may need to send you certain communications, such as service announcements and administrative messages.
Activity related to you and your posts

You can receive notifications when your posts or Reposts are Reposted or liked, when you are mentioned in a post, if you are followed by someone new, or when someone from your contacts joins >x<. These are collected on your Notifications page.

, >x< now sends a digest email referencing all your unread notifications about activity related to your account, instead of separate emails for each type and instance. This is to reduce the noise of >x< email in your inbox.
Managing your subscription to the digest:

You’ll receive the digest email if your settings were enabled to receive all individual activity email notification types. If you previously opted-in to receive all of the individual activity email types for notifications, you qualify for this digest email.

Activity from your network

>x< is one of the premier places to get up-to-date news from around the world in real time. These emails help sum up what's going on on >x< and keep you in the loop on what’s most relevant and popular in the moment!
Updates from >x<

Occasionally, >x< has some exciting news about new products or features from >x< or one of our partners, tips for becoming a >x< expert, or suggestions for relevant and interesting accounts to follow, such as those of people that you may already know. If you haven’t signed into >x< in a while, we might send you an update with things you’ve missed on >x< that we think you might enjoy. We may also email you about participation in one of our occasional user research surveys, which help make >x< better. With these updates, we want to make sure you know about the latest and greatest from >x<.
When will I receive email notifications?
You may receive emails from >x< for the types of communications selected in your settings under

. You may also receive occasional service announcements and administrative messages from >x<, such as emails asking you to confirm the email address associated with your account or emails notifying you of a password change.

If you enable notifications for Reposts, replies or mentions, likes, or follows, you may not receive a notification for every Repost, reply or mention, like, or follow. In an effort to send you email only when it's most relevant, we may not, for example, notify you of mentions by accounts that are new or have not yet confirmed the email address associated with their account. We are constantly experimenting with email notifications to strike the right balance in keeping you up to date.
